target: Turn sampled response certificates into continuous-energy enclosures and improve the unresolved eta=0.01 scan without changing the fixed finite Hamiltonian or supplied source.
completion_criteria: Self-contained audited interpolation theorem with exact finite implementation checks
Continuous enclosures and model-comparison bounds over a declared whole energy interval
A bounded larger-cache experiment and adaptive-energy refinement for eta=0.01, preserving unresolved cases honestly
Integrate verified results into the existing response explorer, retain Stage 15 evidence, and complete CI/deployment/live verification

routes.mechanism: Extend the polynomial cache to 512 actions and compare 256/512 on the same 41 narrow-broadening samples
routes.discriminator: Does truncation error fall below the declared 0.1 inverse-Hartree precision budget, or is it still dominant?
routes.failure_meaning: The polynomial prefix needs a changed budget or method; it does not refute convergence or the old recovery theorem
routes.outcome: 512 actions reduced the maximum original-grid radius from 0.4991642771690414 at 256 columns to 1.7398080847301682e-6 at 512 columns in the same blocked implementation; allocation failures are retained separately.

routes.mechanism: Use the exact resolvent divided-difference identity and endpoint response strength to enclose linear interpolation throughout every energy cell
routes.discriminator: Exact scalar/matrix identities, pointwise inclusion checks, and whole-interval sign separation using current data
routes.failure_meaning: Reject or restrict the candidate inequality before any continuous-band publication
routes.outcome: Analytic Hermitian interpolation implication established with project self-review; 324 exact matrix identities/inclusions and a nonnormal counterexample checked. Existing endpoint data give 840 continuous cells with no new H actions; eta=0.1, k=128 separates both models throughout the interval by more than 0.02365 per Hartree.

routes.mechanism: Refine energy cells using the continuous certificate while reusing a prepared immutable Q/HQ cache
routes.discriminator: Meet the stated absolute display tolerance on all cells with zero new H actions during mesh refinement; report evaluated energies separately from actions
routes.failure_meaning: Retain sampled certificates and the precise unresolved cells; change cache order or tolerance transparently
routes.outcome: Prepared-cache refinement from 41 to 166 nodes gives 165 cells with maximum radius 0.09734338705557741 per Hartree, below the 0.1 budget; 125 extra energy evaluations use zero additional H actions.

conventions: Same exact symmetry-completed real H10-derived (5,4) ion operator and stored real source bits as Stage 15; fixed approximate neutral energy is only a coordinate. Positive eta; energy interval E0+[0.30,0.70] Hartree.
resource_contract: Individual runs bounded by wall-clock and log caps, one-thread environment request; at most 768 trial columns and 2049 mesh nodes in this phase, no full dense 52920-square H. Windows memory is controlled through fixed array dimensions, not an OS limit.
claim_policy: Analytic interpolation theorem is distinct from finite tests. Inherited endpoint FP certificates remain conditional on their binary64 primitive model and guards. No exact neutral source, basis-set, continuum, experimental accuracy, novelty or optimized-speed claim.

handoff.publication: Await PR checks, merge, Pages deployment and live revision/asset/browser verification. Delivery status is recorded separately after those checks.
handoff.next_research: Compare optimized rational or block methods, or study narrower broadening/stricter precision; physical source, finite-basis and experimental accuracy remain open.
handoff.review: Project self-review only; no independent or proof-assistant review.
